fact: Flutter commands for divine-mobile should be run from mobile/.
recommendation: Use commands such as cd mobile && flutter test, cd mobile && flutter analyze, and cd mobile && dart format --set-exit-if-changed . when validating app changes.

fact: divine-mobile is dark-mode only and should use VineTheme plus shared components from mobile/packages/divine_ui rather than one-off raw Colors.* styling.
recommendation: Before adding UI, look for an existing Divine UI component and theme token; update goldens intentionally for visual changes.

fact: If generated-code inputs change, divine-mobile requires dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs and committing the generated outputs.
recommendation: Run build_runner after touching Riverpod, Freezed, JSON serialization, mock generation, Drift schema, or other generator-backed source.
